descriptionHtml: Bank, credit bureau and register all down together: creation gets no products, confirmation is rejected as expected (covered in applications.confirm.integration.test.ts) — this test's focus is that the async scoring chain on an already-confirmed application never throws an unhandled rejection and still reaches WAITONGOPERATOR with everything empty.
